guidanceDebug.textSnippet: EX-99.1 2 dxcm09302025-exhibit991.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 Dexcom Reports Third Quarter 2025 Financial Results and Updates Full Year 2025 Guidance SAN DIEGO - (BUSINESS WIRE-October 30, 2025) - DexCom, Inc. (Nasdaq: DXCM) today reported its financial results as of and for the quarter ended September 30, 2025. guidanceDebug.textSnippet: EX-99 2 q32025earningspressrelease.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 | | | | CoStar Group Q3 Revenue Increases 20% Year-over-Year, Net New Bookings up 92% Year-over-Year to $84 million Arlington, VA - October 28, 2025 - CoStar Group, Inc.
